STATUS: fail
SUMMARY: Two blocking bugs reproduce, both in Dialog when one dialog is nested in another: one Escape closes both dialogs, and Tab inside the inner dialog is pulled out to the outer dialog. Tabs, the Combobox-in-Dialog Escape and form Enter cases, and the Tabs and Combobox edge cases I probed all held.
FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file src/__probe__.test.tsx was created, run, and deleted; `git status` matches the starting state)
FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Nested Dialogs: one Escape closes both. `<Dialog open onOpenChange={outer}><Dialog open onOpenChange={inner}>` then `{Escape}` gives outer called with `false` and inner called once. Cause: each Dialog adds its own document keydown listener with no top-layer check. Violates the "Escape closes only the top layer" check.
- [blocking] Nested Dialogs: Tab escapes the inner trap. Outer `<button>Outer btn</button>` is before an inner dialog with Inner A and Inner B. Focus on Inner B, `userEvent.tab()` moves focus to "Outer btn". Focus on Inner A, Tab moves focus to the outer dialog container, not Inner B. Cause: the outer trapTab sees the portaled inner dialog as "outside" and moves focus to its own first element, and both trap listeners call preventDefault.
- [minor] Not reproduced: SSR or first render has no tabbable tab, because `enabledValues` starts empty and fills in a layout effect.
- [minor] Not reproduced: Combobox `options.indexOf` ids collide if two options share a value.
CHECKS:
- Nested Dialog Escape (outer and inner spies) -> FAIL (both called)
- Nested Dialog Tab from last inner button -> FAIL (focus to Outer btn)
- Nested Dialog Tab from first inner button -> FAIL (focus to outer dialog container)
- Single dialog with an ancestor dialog, Tab wrap -> FAIL (same cause as above)
- Combobox open inside Dialog, Escape closes listbox only, second Escape closes Dialog once -> pass
- Combobox closed inside Dialog, Escape closes Dialog -> pass
- Combobox open inside form, Enter does not submit -> pass
- Combobox closed inside form, Enter submits natively -> pass (expected)
- Two Tabs with identical values -> distinct ids, pass
- Tabs values "a b", `x"y`, "_", "_95_", "a.b", "a:b", "", "é", "a\nb", "%20" -> unique ids, aria-controls and aria-labelledby resolve, pass
- Dialog with focusable inside display:none, Tab skips it -> pass
- Dialog open/Escape/reopen three times, focus returns to opener each time -> pass
- Tabs selected tab disabled -> exactly one tabbable, pass
- Tabs selected tab removed (controlled) -> one tabbable, one selected, one visible panel, pass
- Combobox prepend while active -> active stays "Pear", Enter commits pear, pass
- Combobox active option removed then re-added -> not chosen, activedescendant null, pass
- Dialog cycle and nested-Dialog Escape, unrelated Escape path -> see above
- Full `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck`: not re-run, per orchestrator
OPEN QUESTIONS: Should nested dialogs be supported? If yes, the fix needs a layer stack (only the top Dialog handles Escape and Tab). If not, the README should say so, since it currently claims nothing about nesting.
